title: A tensor model pushout persists under scalar extension
statement: Let $R,S,T,A,B,P,Q$ be commutative rings, let $S,T,A,B$ be $R$-algebras, let $Q$ be a $P$-algebra, and let $t:S\to T$, $f:A\to B$ be $R$-algebra maps. Write $D_0=S\otimes_RA$, $E_0=S\otimes_RB$, $D_1=T\otimes_RA$, $E_1=T\otimes_RB$, and $d_a=1\otimes f:D_a\to E_a$. Suppose $q:Q\to E_0$ is a ring map and $D_0$ has a $P$-algebra structure such that $d_0$ and $q$ give the same map from $P$, and the square $P\to D_0$, $P\to Q$, $D_0\xrightarrow{d_0}E_0$, $Q\xrightarrow qE_0$ is a pushout (the induced $D_0\otimes_PQ\to E_0$ is an isomorphism). Then $D_1$ has a $P$-algebra structure for which $d_1$ and $q_1=(t\otimes1_B)\circ q$ give the same map from $P$, and the square $P\to D_1$, $P\to Q$, $D_1\xrightarrow{d_1}E_1$, $Q\xrightarrow{q_1}E_1$ is a pushout. No finite-presentation, injectivity, or flatness hypothesis is imposed.

proof.text: Define the maps mD=t tensor id_A and mE=t tensor id_B and check d1 mD = mE d0 on pure tensors, then by additive induction. Set the P-map to D1 to mD composed with the P-map to D0 and the Q-map to E1 to mE composed with q. The square identity and the original scalar tower give all scalar compatibility identities.

Cancellation of base change identifies T tensor_S D0 with D1 and T tensor_S E0 with E1. Their right inclusions become mD and mE by the explicit generator formula. Applying Algebra.IsPushout.of_equiv to the canonical tensor pushouts gives pushouts S-T-D0-D1 and S-T-E0-E1.

Apply the pushout pasting equivalence Algebra.IsPushout.comp_iff to S-D0-E0 and T-D1-E1. Since both the left square and the rectangle are pushouts, D0-E0-D1-E1 is a pushout. Flip this square. Apply the same pasting equivalence to P-D0-D1 and Q-E0-E1: the hypothesis and the flipped square give the desired rectangle P-D1-Q-E1. The Lean proof writes every required scalar tower explicitly.

theorem tensor_model_pushout_base_change
    (R : Type u) (S : Type v) (T : Type w) (A : Type x) (B : Type y)
    (P Q : Type z)
    [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [CommRing T] [CommRing A] [CommRing B]
    [CommRing P] [CommRing Q] [Algebra R S] [Algebra R T]
    [Algebra R A] [Algebra R B] [Algebra P Q]
    (t : S →ₐ[R] T) (f : A →ₐ[R] B) (q : Q →+* S ⊗[R] B) (aP : Algebra P (S ⊗[R] A))
    (h : let D := S ⊗[R] A
      let E := S ⊗[R] B
      let d : D →+* E :=
        (Algebra.TensorProduct.map (AlgHom.id S S) f).toRingHom
      letI : Algebra D E := d.toAlgebra
      letI : Algebra Q E := q.toAlgebra
      letI : Algebra P E := (d.comp (algebraMap P D)).toAlgebra
      letI : IsScalarTower P D E := .of_algebraMap_eq fun _ ↦ rfl
      ∃ hPQ : IsScalarTower P Q E,
        letI := hPQ
        Algebra.IsPushout P D Q E) :
    let D := T ⊗[R] A
    let E := T ⊗[R] B
    let d : D →+* E := (Algebra.TensorProduct.map (AlgHom.id T T) f).toRingHom
    letI : Algebra D E := d.toAlgebra
    letI : Algebra Q E :=
      ((Algebra.TensorProduct.map t (AlgHom.id R B)).toRingHom.comp q).toAlgebra
    letI : Algebra P D :=
      ((Algebra.TensorProduct.map t (AlgHom.id R A)).toRingHom.comp
        (algebraMap P (S ⊗[R] A))).toAlgebra
    letI : Algebra P E := (d.comp (algebraMap P D)).toAlgebra
    letI : IsScalarTower P D E := .of_algebraMap_eq fun _ ↦ rfl
    ∃ hPQ : IsScalarTower P Q E,
      letI := hPQ
      Algebra.IsPushout P D Q E
